Inside was a single sheet, folded small, the ink faded to the color of weak tea. He carried it up the spiral stairs and read it by lamplight. A sailor, long dead now, had written to whoever might find it, asking only that someone remember his name and tell the sea he had not been afraid. The keeper set the paper on his table and watched the beam sweep the dark water. In the morning he wrote the name in his logbook, so it would outlast them both.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下渐远的声音。早餐铺的卷帘门半开着，蒸汽在冷空气里升起。送奶工踩着单车，车篮轻轻作响。写字楼的玻璃映着灰蓝的天，几扇窗还亮着灯，不知是谁在熬夜，或是谁刚刚醒来。风掠过梧桐，叶子沙沙低语。这座白天喧嚣的城市，此刻像退潮后的沙滩，安静、湿润，等待下一次涨起的人潮。", "w03": "- Imagine standing between two mirrors: you see yourself inside yourself inside yourself, going on and on.\n- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It stops when the problem gets so small there's nothing left to split, and then all the little answers add back up."}
